en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large formation of mounted and marching soldiers assembled on an open parade ground. In the background are rows of trees and several simple barracks‑style buildings, likely part of a military post. The caption at the top left reads "Fort Walla Walla, Wash:" and there are manuscript catalog numbers "1638." and "8433." written in ink in the upper right corner.
